fact: The World Bank project paper says procurement is ongoing for a GBV management information system to be integrated with the GBV call center and possibly other programme MISs and the national Social Registry.

The Zambia Agency for Persons with Disabilities and ILO's terms of reference, with UN joint programme funding, commission a consultancy from 11 August 2024 to interoperate the Disability Management Information System with ZISPIS, the national social protection information system.
